subject: info-dy
title: INFO.DY.------ALT.FT.
description: First of two diagrams in MP(I)-24. The preceding section (MP(I)-23) ends with the indictment of sixties fragmentation: 'the inability to solidify a composite viewpoint would promote an over-reliance on western ideologies as the most attractive tool for bringing about world change. The effect of this over-reliance is what we are still dealing with as we move into the seventies.' The prose below the diagrams records Cecil Taylor's remark that 'many of the black political activists had practically no knowledge of who they were.' The crossing diagrams the structural shape of that over-reliance: INFO-DY (information dynamics — the form's own information output, anchoring the upper-right with subject-arrow) is crossed with ALT-FT (alternative functionalism). MT-INFO (multi-information) branches down-right from the main line next to the subject, WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) descends from MT-INFO, and TR-INFO (trans-information) branches from WO-EXP-PRI. CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis) descends from the main line, VT-PLT (vibrational platform) branches from CULT-INFO-B, and VT-SY branches from VT-PLT to the right margin — these are what the form's information-dynamics *can* produce as outputs. ALT-FT sits as partner-axis at center-left. POL-P (political policies) branches left from the main line; SOC-RT (social reality) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) branch from POL-P, T-P (time presence) descends from PROG-CONT, and RT-DY (reality dynamics) branches from T-P.
